authorization_origin: Parent relayed new explicit user steering superseding old GMM tier mandate and full Word9 conjunction classifier exclusion
old_family_policy: Cycle06 source/model/type/review artifacts remain immutable archived checkpoint; four GMM ranks and47Word candidates must not be presented as new requested scale result.

new_primary_estimands.spatial: Scale-specific potential functional zones with explicit direct network-time limits, nested smaller units where admissible; not observed trips or census territorial divisions.
new_primary_estimands.typological: Every actually defined unit at every produced scale receives a measured statistical/profile type. Word9 archetypes are interpretation/evidence annotations, not mandatory conjunction gates for assigning a type.
new_primary_estimands.uncertainty: Missing measurements remain NA with observation scope, denominator, source quality and ambiguity; no zero imputation or inferred causal mechanism for label completeness.

scale_contract.numeric_cutpoints_status: Parent owns exact mutuallyexclusive population intervals and response to user preference; no silent replacement of approximate user scales with old GMM ranks.
scale_contract.size_source: Use dated own-center population where observed. External Moscow/SPb federal-subject reference totals remain explicit differently scoped references, not injected own-city observations.
scale_contract.above_tier_cores: Preserve larger-city records at lower scales as protected carry/anchor records with explicit supra-tier role, separate from territorial scale-units and their counts/maps. They may retain measured profiles but are not L0tiny districts. No invented neighbourhood splitting or omitted own-population ledger.
scale_contract.agglomeration_semantics: A millioncity center population threshold identifies anchor size, not independently observed agglomeration footprint. Actual bounded model zone estimates its potential field.
scale_contract.membership_completeness: Every unit must receive a type; this does not force every settlement to attract to an unreachable L5/L6 core. Outside-field and autonomous residual units are retained and typed, not assigned through long chains.

transport_and_nesting.bounded_direct_routes: Freeze time cap and decay at each scale before outcomes, with declared sensitivity. Every accepted ordinary origin-to-center route uses directed direct shortest time plus declared source connectors. Never add hierarchy-leg times to stand in for origin-to-parent travel.
transport_and_nesting.whole_child_admission: A lower unit can enter a higher unit only if all its known routed member origins meet that higher parent's direct-time cap and source/route coverage policy is disclosed. A known beyond-cap member cannot be excused by an average or coverage percentile.
transport_and_nesting.unknown_geometry: Source-unknown/unroutable origins remain unknown. Define separately which observed-native source frame is estimated; report unknown member count/population rather than zero.
transport_and_nesting.no_feasible_parent: Retain lower child autonomously/residually at higher-scale accounting; do not force through distant parent chains or split a preserved child without a separately named partition alternative.
transport_and_nesting.parent_utility: Can aggregate fixed-parent-ownMi gravity over direct member-to-parent routes using preregistered observed population weights. Aggregation defines choice utility; it must not refit or enlarge ownMi using its predicted catchment population.
transport_and_nesting.operational_caps: Exact caps are preregistered scenario settings, not attributed to Soviet authors or presented as observed commute tolerances. L5/L6 remain geographically bounded, not nationwide capital assignments.
transport_and_nesting.scalability: Bounded short-time L0 fields can be streamed/pruned; retaining all reachable candidates is required for a full Huff denominator. A topK truncation must be explicitly treated as an approximation with denominator/label sensitivity, not silently equivalent.

separate_axes: whole additive-member/including-core trajectory with source scope
mandatory_measured_typology.source_qualified_dynamics: Use available2002/2010/2021 endpoints with fixed annual stability epsilon and explicit period. Preserve unknown denominator/zero-initial/center-population scope; distinguish legacy protected2010 from direct primary.
mandatory_measured_typology.label_strategy: A valid mandatory label may be a composite observed profile code or preregistered missing-aware statistical cluster plus an interpretable profile name. Full causal/Word evidence never gates every unit out.
mandatory_measured_typology.missing_features: Explicit trajectory_unknown or context_unobserved components accompany an otherwise measured own/scale/function profile. If all dynamic inputs are unknown, assign a named data-limited observed-profile stratum rather than an invented growth/decline class or all-unknown record without a type.
mandatory_measured_typology.clustering_if_selected: Freeze features, transformations, source quality policy, missing-aware distance/likelihood, number-of-clusters selection and minimal observed dimensions before outcome inspection. Missingness must not act as artificial numeric zero; diagnostics and fallback profile strata remain visible.
mandatory_measured_typology.word_annotations: For each statistical/profile type retain candidate Word-archetype similarities, supporting/contradicted/unknown criteria and actual mechanism witnesses. No fabricated one-to-one mapping to9archetypes; multiple references or no strong Word analogy are permitted.
mandatory_measured_typology.comparison: Compare within-scale distributions and stability; separate fixed-center/type descriptive differences from changed geometry/center eligibility/source coverage. A mandatory label is not proof of a functional or causal mechanism.
mandatory_measured_typology.minimum_observed_basis: No arbitrary trajectory-unknown padding type. Every assigned profile code must cite actual observed features and its minimum-observation rule; missing trajectory is a separate flag, never a fabricated dynamic class. Anchor/residual records are separately scoped and excluded from wrong-scale territorial type counts.

acceptance_tests_before_new_results: Mutuallyexclusive exact center-size tier assignment with explicit external-reference/above-tier roles, no silent GMM reuse
All output units at all produced levels have nonempty measured type codes and source/uncertainty fields
No imputed zero where source value missing; known zero remains distinguishable
No accepted known routed member exceeds its parent scale's declared direct-time cap
Whole-child memberships are nested or explicit residual/alternative status; no hidden chain extension
All population accounting preserves own/territorial/context/additive scope and external-core unknowns
OwnMi remains independent of its predicted surround; type fitting/threshold choice is not externally validated on reused labels
Source coverage and remaining unknown geometry reported nationally and by level/type
Atlas shows new levels/types with parameter/source labels and no invented fine territorial borders
Independent full source/math/visual review plus finite sensitivity and durable reproducibility for the new family
